tools.name: review_code
tools.description: Void's instant code review: pattern checks for bugs, risks and style in pasted code or a diff's added lines, in many languages. The same checks a-to-mind.com runs when someone asks Void to review code. No model; the closer read is not included. Its structured result says basis 'patterns' and confide

tools.name: review_code_closer
tools.description: Void's code review with the closer read: the instant checks, then an AI reviewer that confirms real findings, drops wrong ones and adds what the patterns missed, each quoting its line. The closer read needs a key in the MCP request's Authorization header (Bearer: a Void Pro review key vr1.… or a Voi

tools.name: moon_phase
tools.description: The moon's illuminated fraction, whether it is waxing or waning, and the phase's name for a moment, from Meeus' formulas (Astronomical Algorithms, ch. 47-48).

tools.name: meteor_showers
tools.description: The meteor showers active on a date (strongest first, with days to each peak and the peak rate) and the next peak on or after it, from the IMO calendar of the major showers.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "review_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "review_code_closer" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
